Hi! I need some help with a couple of things related to my recent move. First, I realized one of my orders was sent to my old address on Elm Avenue here in Houston, but I’ve already updated my new address for another order. I’d like to have the order that’s going to the old address redirected to my new place, and also set my new address as my default for future orders. I’d prefer not to share my address directly—could you please look it up in my orders?

Also, I’d like to exchange the tablet I ordered for the most affordable one you have, since I’m trying to save after the move. Can you help me with all of this?
Sure, my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else to verify my account!
Yes, that all sounds correct! Please go ahead with updating my default address and redirecting the order, and exchange the tablet for the cheapest one as you described. Thank you!

That’s perfect, thank you so much for your help! I don’t have any other requests right now. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
